about_the_game:
Somewhere, a cat sleeps

For those who have loved a cat.
For those who have lost one.

Walk between dream and reality, where time drifts without meaning.
One dream leads to another, and the searching never stops. A cat is always there, waiting, somewhere in the shifting haze. Each dream holds another inside it, opening like doors you didn’t know were there. Step through them, and the wandering begins again.

Explore the nothingness, the randomness, the endlessness. Forget about time. Read the poems of Khayyam by the fire. Push objects until they fall, or let them stand untouched. Do nothing. Do everything. Live like a cat.

The Cat Memorial

The Cat Memorial is a dedicated space to honor the cats who have shared our dreams, our days, and our lives. You are invited to add your own: send me a message with your cat’s name, a poem, or a few words meant only for them, and they will become part of the memorial. The Cat Memorial will be available as a free demo, an eternal place you can return to, to sit quietly and visit your cats whenever you wish. Read the pinned news on top of this page or check the community hub for how to submit your messages. 

Features

  • Explore strange dream worlds, each holding its own secret logic

  • Find hidden paths from one dream into another

  • Breathe with the cats, and let them rest on you forever

  • Read timeless poems by Omar Khayyam

  • Watch as cats fall like rain from nowhere

  • Visit the Cat Memorial, to share your love with the world.

  • A meditative walking simulator about patience, loss, and the philosophy of cats

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Between the veil of night and dawn, a cat once loved still wanders on. A meditative walking simulator about cats, patience, love, and loss.
